articles.title: Trump warns he’s close to Iran decision as Middle East tensions escalate: ‘When do I blow the entire nation up?’ - nypost.com
articles.description: Trump’s warning comes as the US-Iran conflict enters its seventh month.
articles.content: President Trump revealed Sunday he is considering “blowing up” all of Iran and that “very big things are going to be happening” soon as he left a retreat at Camp David a day early so he could return … [+3600 chars]
